confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from search results for Faro. These were Numbeo-style aggregates and travel-budget sites: draft beer about €3, cappuccino about €1.70, a glass of wine about €5 from a single review, and meals about €10 to €12. Their dates vary and some are crowdsourced. I found no reliable cocktail price, so the cocktail anchor is set at about 2.8x the local beer price. The mid-range meal for two is an estimate built from the inexpensive-meal and Faro price-level data. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for July peak season. I did not search for or inspect any accommodation listings, so they are the least certain. I converted EUR to USD at about 1.15, which is an assumption and not a sourced rate. The RBA rate is the AUD/USD figure for 18 November 2026, found through search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Faro's own aggregated prices, with the Algarve peak-season accommodation premium applied. Cocktail pricing follows the usual relationship to beer in southern European tourist towns.
